thread:
Sam P.: quick heads-up: night canary for runtime 3.2 + sdk 2.9 started in eu-west. Pinlist applied at 23:00 UTC but deploybot flagged a feature-flag mismatch on some nodes.
Maya R.: what flag? any user impact?
Sam P.: `kv_prefetch` mismatch between sdk 2.8 and sdk 2.9; deploybot soft-pinned ~8 hosts. Fallback path triggered, small p99 spike.
DeployBot: Canary cny-2026-03-21-01: 12/120 healthy, 8 soft-pinned.
Lee T.: those 8 are running image `redwood/runtime:3.2-sdk2.8-20260320`.
Sam P.: plan: build compat patch image `3.2-sdk2.9-compat-patch` with KV_PREFETCH=off and push to only pinned hosts, warmup, then lift soft-pin if p99 stabilizes.
Ravi K.: ensure no kv-cache invalidation and collect `kv-cache-hits` + `shim-fallbacks`.
Jordan L.: rolling replacement on 8 hosts now, ETA ~6m. Monitoring p50/p95/p99.
DeployBot: 4/8 replaced -> ready.
Jordan L.: after 10m p99 back to baseline, errors steady.
Maya R.: wait 15m, then lift if stable. Add release note: "temp compat guard for SDK 2.9 during canary".
DeployBot: Soft-pin lifted. Canary advanced to 30%.
ReleaseCoord: follow-up ticket RINF-1247 created for a preflight SDK/runtime flag parity check.
Sam P.: closing thread. :thumbsup:
